item.name: 10 Admin
item.description: Admin-only area. Self-contained: logs in the seeded admin (`npm run seed`), registers its own customer (for 403 checks and the activate/deactivate story), then checks the dashboard, sales report (+ CSV), streamed orders CSV, inventory, low stock and customer management. Assertions use invariants (totals = sum of rows) so they pass on any data set.

exec: pm.test('status is 200 (run npm run seed first)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
// Folder 10 creates its OWN customer: used for the 403 checks and the activate/deactivate story
pm.test('range defaults to 30d in UTC', () => { pm.expect(stats.range).to.eql('30d'); pm.expect(stats.timezone).to.eql('UTC'); });
pm.test('orders by status add up to the total', () => pm.expect(stats.ordersByStatus.reduce((s, x) => s + x.count, 0)).to.eql(stats.totalOrders));
pm.test('low stock is part of the active products', () => pm.expect(stats.lowStockCount).to.be.at.most(stats.totalProducts));
pm.test('our new customer counts as new', () => pm.expect(stats.newCustomers).to.be.at.least(1));
pm.test('at most 5 recent orders and top products', () => { pm.expect(stats.recentOrders.length).to.be.at.most(5); pm.expect(stats.topProducts.length).to.be.at.most(5); });

item.name: Sales report – January 2026 by week, Pakistan time

exec: pm.test('local midnight of 1 Jan is 19:00 UTC on 31 Dec', () => pm.expect(report.from).to.eql('2025-12-31T19:00:00.000Z'));
